title: Bulk CSV import for enterprise
synthesis_oneliner: Blocking 3 deals worth $480k ARR. Sales escalated this week.
rationale_narrative: This unblocks 3 deals worth $480k ARR. Sales escalated it this week — second time this quarter. The pattern is clear: enterprise buyers expect bulk import on day one.

evidence.label: ARR exposure
evidence.quote: Acme — 'Without bulk import we can't migrate from our current vendor.'

title: SSO via SAML
synthesis_oneliner: Required for 2 enterprise renewals — $340k ARR at risk.
rationale_narrative: Two enterprise renewals in Q4 are conditional on SAML SSO. This is table-stakes for enterprise; without it, we churn $340k ARR. The implementation is well-scoped.

title: Webhook delivery retries
synthesis_oneliner: Top reliability complaint — 18 tickets, 3 customer escalations.
rationale_narrative: Webhook delivery is the #1 reliability complaint this quarter. Customers report missed events with no retry. Eng has a clean fix scoped at 1 sprint with dead-letter queue.

title: Audit log export for SOC2
synthesis_oneliner: SOC2 Type II prep — required by Q4 audit window.
rationale_narrative: Required for SOC2 Type II compliance. Audit window is October — we need export-ready audit logs by end of Q3 to be safe. No customer pull yet, but compliance is non-negotiable for enterprise expansion.

conflicts: Slight overlap with bulk import in Sprint 3 — manageable

title: Slack integration v2 — threaded notifications
synthesis_oneliner: High-volume request from CS — but low ARR exposure.
rationale_narrative: CS has been pushing for threaded Slack notifications for two quarters. The volume of requests is high (24 in Productboard) but the ARR impact is unclear — most asks are from customers under $20k MRR.

conflicts: Lower ROI than enterprise items in same window

title: Permission groups (vs individual ACLs)
synthesis_oneliner: Mid-size customer pain — 8 tickets from $50k+ MRR accounts.
rationale_narrative: Mid-market customers (>$50k MRR) repeatedly hit the limit of individual ACLs. They need group permissions. Solid signal across 8 tickets and 3 customer interviews.

title: Mobile push notifications
synthesis_oneliner: Low signal — 4 requests, no revenue tie. Defer.
rationale_narrative: Mobile push has been requested 4 times but with no revenue tie and no support volume. Recommend monitoring; not worth Q3 capacity.

title: Custom field types in workflows
rationale_narrative: Custom field types (date, dropdown, multi-select) are a growing request across mid-market and enterprise. Themes are consolidating; worth scoping for Q4.
